**Texas Tech K-12 Full-Time Tuition-Paid Program Overview**

---

**Program Description**
- The Full-Time Tuition-Paid Program is designed for students who need the flexibility of online education, including:
  - Non-Texas residents
  - Texas residents seeking more flexibility than the tuition-free program
  - Homeschooled students or those needing a non-traditional school setting

- Students can enroll in a wide range of accredited K-12 courses, including core subjects, electives, foreign languages, and Advanced Placement (AP) courses.
- The program is fully online and self-paced, allowing students to start at any time and work at their own pace.

---

**Key Features**
- **Accreditation:** Texas Tech K-12 is accredited by Cognia and approved by the Texas Education Agency (TEA).
- **Personalized Learning:** Flexible pacing and personalized support from Texas-certified teachers and academic advisors.
- **Comprehensive Curriculum:** Access to all required courses for a Texas high school diploma, as well as electives and AP courses.
- **Support Services:** Academic advisors, counselors, and technical support are available.

---

**Tuition and Fees (Effective September 1, 2022)**
- **Admission Fee:** $200 (Texas/US), $250 (International) — non-refundable
- **Online Courses:** $300 per course (Texas/US), $450 per course (International)
- **Online Credit By Exams:** $80 per exam (Texas/US), not available internationally
- **Print Surcharge:** $25
- **Transcript Request:** $5
- **Overnight Shipping:** $30 (not available internationally)
- **Returned Check:** $30
- **Optional Print Materials (K-3):** $20
- **Diploma Replacement:** $25

**Payment Policies**
- Payment is due upon enrollment; payment plans are not available.
- All CBE (Credit by Exam) fees are non-refundable. Print CBEs can be substituted.
- Once a student submits an assignment for grading, they are no longer eligible for a refund in the tuition-paid or supplemental programs.

---

**Enrollment Process**
1. **Submit an Application:** Complete the online application and provide required documentation (birth certificate, previous transcripts if applicable).
   - [Submit an Application](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/enroll/)
2. **Enrollment Confirmation:** Receive confirmation once your application is reviewed and accepted.
3. **Course Selection:** Meet with an academic advisor to select courses.
4. **Begin Learning:** Start courses at any time and access all online resources.

---

**Academic Requirements**
- Students must maintain enrollment in a minimum of four semester courses.
- Each course must be completed within six months of enrollment.
- A passing course grade is 70% or higher.
- Grades are calculated as 50% coursework average and 50% summative assessment average (including the final exam).

---

**Technology Requirements**
- Modern computer (≤5 years old) with webcam/microphone
- Windows 10+, macOS 11+, ChromeOS, or Linux (Ubuntu 18.04+)
- Latest versions of Chrome (required for online exams), Firefox, Edge, or Safari (macOS only)
- Broadband internet (at least 1.5 Mbps)
- JavaScript, cookies, and pop-ups enabled; ad blockers disabled
- Desktop or laptop required for full functionality (mobile devices not recommended for coursework or proctored exams)

---

**Textbooks**
- Most courses do not require separate textbook purchases; required materials are provided unless otherwise specified.
- Some AP courses may require a textbook or additional materials. Specific instructions will be provided if needed.

---

**Who Should Apply?**
- Students outside Texas seeking a fully accredited K-12 program
- Texas residents wanting more flexibility than the tuition-free program
- Students needing a non-traditional or homeschool-friendly environment

---

**Contact & Support**
- For questions or assistance, contact Texas Tech K-12 at 1-800-692-6877 or ttuk12@ttu.edu.

---

**Additional Resources**
- [Tuition & Fees Information](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/about/fees/)
- [Parent Portal](https://ttu.focusschoolsoftware.com/focus/auth/)

Online instruction presents different challenges than those in a traditional classroom. The curriculum is rigorous and is reading- and writing-intensive. Successful online students are able to take initiative and manage their own time.

**Enrollment Timing After Leaving a School (Texas Tech K-12 Guidance)**

- **No Specific Mandatory Gap:**  
Texas Tech K-12 does not specify a required waiting period between leaving your current institution and enrolling in Texas Tech K-12 or another institution.

- **Recommended Practice:**  
It is recommended that students complete their current semester at their previous school before withdrawing and enrolling with Texas Tech K-12. This helps ensure smooth grade-level placement and credit transfer.

- **Immediate Enrollment:**  
Students may generally enroll in Texas Tech K-12 as soon as they have withdrawn from their previous school, provided they have the necessary documentation (such as transcripts and proof of withdrawal).

- **Important Considerations:**
  - For the Tuition-Free Full-Time Program, you must withdraw from your local school district to attend Texas Tech K-12 full-time.
  - If you transfer before completing a semester, you may be assigned intervention coursework, required to repeat the previous semester, or asked to complete placement assessments for appropriate placement.
